scope: Capture Color Space mode 0x53 rendering on Q7 firmware 1.01. Four bounded queue/refresh dispatches with staged text and shape commands, plus two real indexed marker blits to synthetic RAM.

findings.refresh: UiService_Refresh(1) 0x80ae00f0 sends the four-word request [0x80,1,0,0] through original UiService_SendRequest 0x80adfeb8. UiService_Perform 0x80adf734 takes command 0x80 to 0x80adf968 and calls UiService_DoRefresh(3) at 0x80adf978. DoRefresh updates the root, takes the full redraw branch, then calls GuiComponent_Write for passes 0 and 1. The RTOS wait/send/receive/semaphore mechanics are modeled, and the fixture stops the thread immediately after one consumed command.
findings.draw_order: GuiCanvas_Write 0x80aca164 traverses active drawing entries before regular children when active canvas state and the matching write-pass condition hold. A native key change switches the active list. Both option text rows are drawn in all four refreshes, but only the active option supplies its highlight, marker and guide. Regular option icon IDs are 0x586 and 0x588. The selected marker resource ID is 0x25 for both options.
findings.highlight: The active solid-line widgets are 0x0191d00c (sRGB) and 0x0191d011 (AdobeRGB); their table type is 0x11. Although the table argument is 0x0f, native GuiSolidLine_WriteSolidLineInfo 0x80ad9104 emits five geometry/color tuples with palette indices 0x4d,0x4d,0x4f,0x4f,0x4e in this branch. The logical region is x=0, width=720, height=48, at y=64 or 112. Shape rasterization and palette-to-RGB mapping are outside the replay.
findings.text: Type-9 labels update a current descriptor and GuiStringLabel_WriteStringInfo routes these labels through ResourceString_DrawString/DrawStringChangeColor. The latter reads locale at 0x80b7b32c, indexes the original language table, and loops over the descriptor's line count and per-line u8 length. It copies two bytes per unit into a one-line stack buffer before I43_DBTextOut and AppDBTextOutByBufferID. The replay captures original payload hashes, logical X/Y and count before GDI glyph execution. The static next calls are GdiTextOutDB and an indirect font rendering path; staged glyph units alone establish no glyph pixel shape.
findings.locale: Table slot 0 names English and slot 1 names French in the original descriptors. The two option payload hashes are unchanged between these fixtures. The French AdobeRGB guide stages two lines at y=280 and y=328; English guide stages one at y=280. The fixture writes the locale index and does not replay language selection or font registration.
findings.marker: The focus icon's logical width is 16 and its bitmap width is 21, both height 48. ResourceIcon_DrawIcon uses the original RLE pairs, expands exactly 1,008 bytes and writes 330 nonzero palette indices at each option position on synthetic 96-byte-stride RAM. A native GetBuffer boundary is replaced by the supplied pointer/stride/height. Transparent zeros preserve destination, and the full synthetic frame, decoded bytes and writable ranges are checked.
findings.buffer: Native ScreenControl_Update calls ScreenOsdLayer_Roll 0x8043ca4c, requests cache writeback/invalidate over the draw buffer, and passes old draw as new show via ScreenOsdLayer_SetOsd and I43_OSDSetShowBufferEx. Modeled buffers 17 and 18 exchange roles in each refresh. Static continuation AppOsdSetShowBufferByLayerID can select a display context and call AppOsdSelectDisplayContextByLayerID, which reads the context's memory pointer and buffer attributes before LayerSetFrameBuffer 0x800442f8 and LayerMove 0x80044370. The harness captures the show request and returns from a replacement at 0x8029ef58 without executing the downstream display-context body. Original code resumes at 0x8043ca34, returns through refresh to the consumer, and stops at 0x80adf980. DMA consumption and final LCD output remain unverified.
findings.lifecycle: The rendering fixture starts after original Color Space mode open. Native option navigation immediately updates the same 0xd7 menu RAM value observed by the prior state checker. Prior replay establishes retain-on-confirm, rollback-on-cancel and reread-on-reopen. This rendering fixture does not replay those terminal actions.

references.use: Shared Color Space action/semantic vocabulary. Renderer and resource ABI are per firmware.
ARM Color Space row preparation assigns model-local text IDs 0x1f6/0x1f7 and style-dependent icons. Its list pending index and confirmation differ from Q7 immediate writes.
Separate ARM direction/focus and presentation callbacks reach their own renderer invalidation and scheduler boundaries. No numerical event, glyph or indexed-pixel compatibility is inferred.

replay.scope: Original mode 0x53 widget construction/focus, UiService refresh producer and consumer, widget update/write, text payload staging, solid-line request generation and OSD buffer roll. Two separate original focus-icon draws compare synthetic indexed-buffer writes byte for byte.

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.

evidence.role: Refresh producer, queue consumer and redraw gate
Widget update/write gates and active draw order
Locale and line staging into GDI API
OSD native roll, cache request and display context boundary
Original indexed icon RLE and nonzero store
Capture Color Space table records and EN/FR label descriptor pointers

limitations: The outer thread wait and queue mechanics are modeled. The request producer, command dispatch and one refresh execute native MIPS. A single delivered command per dispatch does not test asynchronous timing, contention or queue overflow.

Character line payload and shape commands are captured at the stated function boundaries. No glyph-pixel or final focus-frame raster is claimed. Synthetic locale and zero viewport scaling isolate the measured drawing positions.
Only resource 0x25 is independently rasterized. Its whole-frame byte check is indexed RAM and does not establish actual panel size, color, DMA, scanout or transfer timing.
Mode 0x53 build/open runs with the earlier checker hooks. Physical control events, DCF/media effects and terminal actions are outside these drawing fixtures.
